## [1.0.0] — 2026-08-20

First release. Requires **FOS Essentials Core 1.0.0**.

### Added

**Components**

- `FOSAccessList` — holds the sources and answers "does the local player hold the key?".
- `FOSAccessGate` — shows or hides objects depending on that answer, optionally inverted.

**Sources**

- A list of display names **in the inspector**: shipped with the world, answers instantly,
  works with no network at all.
- A list **downloaded from a URL**: edited without publishing the world again. Blank lines
  and `#` comments are ignored, so the file can be annotated.
- A **VRChat Economy product**: owning it grants access, list or no list.
- The **instance master**, optionally, so the world owner is never locked out.

The four are cumulative — any single one granting access is enough. The common case is a
list in the inspector plus a remote one, and nothing forces a choice between them.

**Answering honestly while loading**

- `FOSIsResolved()` separates "not on the list" from "the list has not arrived yet". A
  **yes** is final immediately, since a further source can only ever add people; a **no**
  waits for the download. An interface can then say which of the two it is, instead of
  looking broken.
- A gate decides for itself what to show while a list is still in flight.

**Editor**

- **Import and export** the inspector list, in the same one-name-per-line format as the
  remote list. A list built in the inspector can be exported and hosted as is, and a file
  already online can be pulled back into the prefab.
- **The inspector says when nothing is filled in**, the case where nobody will ever hold
  the key and where no error would otherwise be raised, and counts the names that are
  actually usable — an empty slot in the array is not one.
- **The gate refuses to be its own target.** Hiding itself would stop the behaviour from
  running, so it would never receive the answer meant to bring it back: the object would
  stay dark until the world restarted, with nothing to explain why. The inspector reports
  it instead.
- Inspector labels, sections and messages translated into English, French, Spanish and
  German.

### Notes

This tidies a world, it does not protect it. The answer is computed on the player's own
client and a remote list is public to anyone who finds its URL. Udon offers no server-side
check to appeal to, and the README says so in as many words.
